research_notes: Name: the legal name changed from 'PT Bukit Asam Tbk' to 'Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Bukit Asam Tbk', abbreviated 'PT Bukit Asam (Persero) Tbk' (EGMS 16 Dec 2025 under the 4th BUMN-law amendment, UU 16/2025; notarial deed No. 68 of 14 Jan 2026; MoLHR approval AHU-0008473.AH.01.02.TAHUN 2026 of 13 Feb 2026). Sources: FS2025 Note 1 (PDF p. 22) and the IDX disclosure of 18 Feb 2026 (https://www.ptba.co.id/api/storage/1771402717137-4ea7f25d-039c-4409-be86-70bfbdf734d4.pdf). FS2019-FS2024 and AR2020-AR2024 are under 'PT Bukit Asam Tbk'. Immediate parent MIND ID (65.93%); the Government holds the 5 Series A Dwiwarna shares.
Currency/units: IDR reporter; all money in IDR billion (Rp juta / 1,000). Revenue includes non-coal activities (FY2025: coal 41,909,086 + other 742,638 Rp juta).

Source policy: FY levels/profit/EPS/cash flow from each year's own audited consolidated FS; balance-sheet comparatives in later FS match the original figures (no restatement found for 2019-2024). FY2022: the standalone audited FS PDF on ptba.co.id (reports/20230302151633-2023-03-02ptba_laporan_audit_keuangan151631.pdf) is truncated on the server (Content-Length 6,596,928, no xref/trailer; not in the Wayback Machine), so the audited FS2022 reproduced in AR2022 (PDF p. 763 ff.) is used; FS2023 comparatives agree.

EBITDA: PTBA reports EBITDA only in decks and results releases, without a printed definition. 2024-2025 and 9M figures are exact (Rp juta) from releases; 2021-2023 are chart values printed to 0.1 tn (2023: 10.00). Cross-check: PBT + finance costs + D&A (segment note) is within 0.5% of the reported EBITDA for 2024 and 2025 but not exact. The AR KPI tables print a different, SOE-KPI 'EBITDA' (AR2023 p. 386: 8,902 bn realisation for 2023; AR2024 p. 441: 7,894 for 2024; AR2025 p. 424: 5,875.43 for 2025); those were NOT used.

Treasury shares (net of which shares_out is stated): the 2012-2015 buybacks accumulated 980,283,500 treasury shares, of which 649,987,500 were transferred in 2019, leaving 330,296,000 (AR2025 PDF p. 175; FS2025 Note 23 calls them the 2015 buyback); 2020 buyback 6,302,000 shares (17 Mar-16 Jun 2020, Rp12.52 bn, AR2020 PDF p. 23); 303,148,100 transferred on 22 Sep 2021 by private placement at Rp2,280 (disclosure of 23 Sep 2021, https://www.ptba.co.id/api/storage/documents/20210923131702-2021-09-23ptba_pengumuman131646.pdf); 27,147,900 sold 28 Mar 2024 at Rp2,950 (FS2025 Note 23); 6,302,000 remain and must be transferred by 31 Mar 2029. On 23 Oct 2026 the company said it is studying a possible new share buyback (press release 'Kinerja Melesat, PTBA Siapkan Langkah Strategis Jaga Nilai Perusahaan'); nothing executed as of the 9M2026 FS.

Corporate actions 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-03: none (no split, reverse split, bonus or rights issue). The last split was the 1:5 nominal split of 14 Dec 2017 (AR2025 PDF p. 175 share chronology); AR2025 PDF p. 30 states no material corporate action in 2025; AR2025 PDF p. 176: no bonds/sukuk ever issued. corporate_actions is therefore an empty list and fy.2019.year_end_price is not needed.

Dividends: one final cash dividend per year, no interims (FS dividend notes FS2021 p. 121, AR2022 p. 885, FS2023 p. 113, FS2024 p. 113, FS2025 p. 126, 9M2026 p. 116). Exact DPS and the regular-market cum/ex/recording/payment dates come from the AGMS summary (Ringkasan Risalah RUPST) of each year; the FY2021-FY2024 summaries are scanned PDFs and were read from page renders. FS notes print rounded DPS (75, 689, 1,094, 398, 332, 115).

Operating data: production = 'Total Consolidated Coal Production' from the AR operational highlights (excludes purchased coal); sales volume = total coal sales. ASP and cash cost are deck values in Rp thousand per tonne; FY2025 is only printed as Rp0.92 M/t and Rp0.84 M/t in rupiah (the same deck gives USD 55.99/t and USD 50.76/t). The decks give ASP/cash cost only rounded, so treat them as indicative.
Large time deposits sit outside 'cash' (e.g. Rp9.0 tn end-2021, Rp8.9 tn end-2022, Rp0.5 tn end-2023; AR2025 PDF p. 20), so cash understates liquidity in 2021-2022.
9M2026: profit attributable +216% YoY and EBITDA +102% YoY against a weak 9M2025; the validator's 'YTD profit YoY > 100%' warning is real (9M26 release: ASP +18% YoY, Newcastle/ICI-3 +25%/+26%).

Customers: FY2024 sales mix by volume (FY2024 deck PDF p. 12): export 47%, domestic PLN 36%, domestic mine-mouth 9%, other domestic 8%; domestic share 54% in FY2025 (FY2025 release) and 52% in 9M2026 (9M26 release). Revenue from related parties was Rp20.7 tn in 2022 (FY2022 deck PDF p. 9, 'dominated by MIND ID Trading').
